#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$HOME/qwen38-5090"
VENV="$HOME/.venvs/qwen38"
TARGET="${TARGET:-$ROOT/models/RadixArk-Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4}"
DRAFT="${DRAFT:-$ROOT/models/incoai-Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2}"
DRAFT_QUANTIZATION="${DRAFT_QUANTIZATION:-}"
DRAFT_WINDOW_SIZE="${DRAFT_WINDOW_SIZE:-}"
PORT="${PORT:-30000}"
SERVER_HOST="${SERVER_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
SPEC_ALGORITHM="${SPEC_ALGORITHM:-DFLASH}"
DRAFT_TOKENS="${DRAFT_TOKENS:-8}"
SPEC_NUM_STEPS="${SPEC_NUM_STEPS:-1}"
SPEC_TOPK="${SPEC_TOPK:-1}"
NGRAM_MAX_BREADTH="${NGRAM_MAX_BREADTH:-1}"
NGRAM_MAX_DEPTH="${NGRAM_MAX_DEPTH:-$DRAFT_TOKENS}"
NGRAM_CORPUS_PATH="${NGRAM_CORPUS_PATH:-}"
NGRAM_EXTERNAL_BUDGET="${NGRAM_EXTERNAL_BUDGET:-0}"
DFLASH_BLOCK_SIZE="${DFLASH_BLOCK_SIZE:-$DRAFT_TOKENS}"
CONTEXT_LENGTH="${CONTEXT_LENGTH:-4096}"
MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS="${MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS:-$CONTEXT_LENGTH}"
MEM_FRACTION="${MEM_FRACTION:-0.94}"
MAX_MAMBA_CACHE_SIZE="${MAX_MAMBA_CACHE_SIZE:-5}"
MAMBA_SSM_DTYPE="${MAMBA_SSM_DTYPE:-bfloat16}"
ENABLE_REPLAYSSM_SPEC="${ENABLE_REPLAYSSM_SPEC:-0}"
LINEAR_REPLAYSSM_CACHE_LEN="${LINEAR_REPLAYSSM_CACHE_LEN:-16}"
CHUNKED_PREFILL_SIZE="${CHUNKED_PREFILL_SIZE:-4096}"
LANGUAGE_ONLY="${LANGUAGE_ONLY:-0}"
REASONING_PARSER="${REASONING_PARSER:-}"
TOOL_CALL_PARSER="${TOOL_CALL_PARSER:-}"

for path in "$VENV/bin/activate" "$TARGET/config.json"; do
  if [[ ! -e "$path" ]]; then
    echo "Missing required file: $path" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
if [[ "$SPEC_ALGORITHM" == "DFLASH" && ! -e "$DRAFT/config.json" ]]; then
  echo "Missing required file: $DRAFT/config.json" >&2
  exit 1
fi

source "$VENV/bin/activate"
export HF_HOME="$HOME/.cache/huggingface"
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export MAX_JOBS="${MAX_JOBS:-3}"
export CUDA_HOME="$VENV/lib/python3.12/site-packages/nvidia/cu13"
export PATH="$CUDA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$CUDA_HOME/lib:$CUDA_HOME/lib64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
export LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/lib/wsl/lib:${LIBRARY_PATH:-}"

# NVIDIA's pip wheels keep versioned runtime libraries but omit the unversioned
# linker names required by FlashInfer's one-time JIT builds.
for lib in cudart cublas cublasLt; do
  versioned="$(find "$CUDA_HOME/lib" -maxdepth 1 -name "lib${lib}.so.*" -print -quit)"
  if [[ -n "$versioned" && ! -e "$CUDA_HOME/lib/lib${lib}.so" ]]; then
    ln -s "$(basename "$versioned")" "$CUDA_HOME/lib/lib${lib}.so"
  fi
done

echo "Starting Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 + $SPEC_ALGORITHM speculation"
echo "port=$PORT draft_tokens=$DRAFT_TOKENS steps=$SPEC_NUM_STEPS topk=$SPEC_TOPK dflash_block=$DFLASH_BLOCK_SIZE context=$CONTEXT_LENGTH mem_fraction=$MEM_FRACTION replayssm_spec=$ENABLE_REPLAYSSM_SPEC"

EXTRA_ARGS=()
if [[ -n "$REASONING_PARSER" ]]; then
  EXTRA_ARGS+=(--reasoning-parser "$REASONING_PARSER")
fi
if [[ -n "$TOOL_CALL_PARSER" ]]; then
  EXTRA_ARGS+=(--tool-call-parser "$TOOL_CALL_PARSER")
fi
if [[ "$LANGUAGE_ONLY" == "1" ]]; then
  EXTRA_ARGS+=(--json-model-override-args '{"language_model_only":true}')
fi
if [[ "$ENABLE_REPLAYSSM_SPEC" == "1" ]]; then
  EXTRA_ARGS+=(
    --enable-linear-replayssm-spec
    --linear-replayssm-cache-len "$LINEAR_REPLAYSSM_CACHE_LEN"
  )
fi
SPEC_ARGS=()
if [[ -n "$DRAFT_WINDOW_SIZE" ]]; then
  SPEC_ARGS+=(--speculative-draft-window-size "$DRAFT_WINDOW_SIZE")
fi
if [[ -n "$DRAFT_QUANTIZATION" ]]; then
  SPEC_ARGS+=(--speculative-draft-model-quantization "$DRAFT_QUANTIZATION")
fi
SPEC_COMMON_ARGS=()
if [[ "$SPEC_ALGORITHM" != "NONE" ]]; then
  SPEC_COMMON_ARGS+=(
    --speculative-algorithm "$SPEC_ALGORITHM"
    --speculative-num-steps "$SPEC_NUM_STEPS"
    --speculative-eagle-topk "$SPEC_TOPK"
    --speculative-num-draft-tokens "$DRAFT_TOKENS"
    --speculative-ngram-min-bfs-breadth 1
    --speculative-ngram-max-bfs-breadth "$NGRAM_MAX_BREADTH"
    --speculative-ngram-max-trie-depth "$NGRAM_MAX_DEPTH"
  )
fi
if [[ "$SPEC_ALGORITHM" == "DFLASH" ]]; then
  SPEC_ARGS+=(
    --speculative-draft-model-path "$DRAFT"
    --speculative-dflash-block-size "$DFLASH_BLOCK_SIZE"
  )
fi
if [[ "$SPEC_ALGORITHM" == "NGRAM" && -n "$NGRAM_CORPUS_PATH" ]]; then
  SPEC_ARGS+=(
    --speculative-ngram-external-corpus-path "$NGRAM_CORPUS_PATH"
    --speculative-ngram-external-sam-budget "$NGRAM_EXTERNAL_BUDGET"
  )
fi

exec python -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path "$TARGET" \
  --served-model-name qwen38 \
  --host "$SERVER_HOST" \
  --port "$PORT" \
  --quantization modelopt_fp4 \
  --fp4-gemm-backend flashinfer_cutlass \
  "${SPEC_COMMON_ARGS[@]}" \
  "${SPEC_ARGS[@]}" \
  --enable-single-batch-overlap \
  --attention-backend flashinfer \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
  --max-running-requests 1 \
  --max-total-tokens "$MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS" \
  --chunked-prefill-size "$CHUNKED_PREFILL_SIZE" \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 1 \
  --cuda-graph-bs-decode 1 \
  --disable-prefill-cuda-graph \
  --mem-fraction-static "$MEM_FRACTION" \
  --mamba-ssm-dtype "$MAMBA_SSM_DTYPE" \
  --max-mamba-cache-size "$MAX_MAMBA_CACHE_SIZE" \
  --context-length "$CONTEXT_LENGTH" \
  "${EXTRA_ARGS[@]}"
